java.label: Basic Solution
java.code: public static String sortStringsAlphabetically(String input) { return Arrays.stream(input.split("\s+")).sorted().collect(Collectors.joining(" ")); }
java.note: Good to try: this is readable and compact, but the stream chain is usually less explicit than the cleaner loop-based explanation when the interviewer wants exact control.

java.label: Alternative
java.code: public static String sortStringsAlphabetically(String input) { List<String> words = Arrays.asList(input.split("\s+")); Collections.sort(words); return String.join(" ", words); }
